in_marathi.name: Idhayan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Heart, Mind, Consciousness
in_marathi.long_meaning: Idhayan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Idhayan is a Sanskrit name derived from the term ‘idham’, which means ‘heart’, and ‘yan’, which means ‘movement’ or ‘consciousness’. This name is significant in Hindu mythology, where it is believed to symbolize the journey of the soul from the heart to the divine.
